snippet.title: Launch Trailer for "THE BENDS"! A #Hps1 Summer of Shivers #GameJam entry.
snippet.description:
Trailer 2 - the Launch Trailer for "The Bends" 

The game will be released for free on Itch.io for the #HPS1 Summer of Shivers jam, AUGUST 31st!  

https://phantomsloth.itch.io/the-bends

Be sure to follow me on twitter for more updates on other games and possible future updates on this game. 

https://twitter.com/Phant0mSl0th #GAMEDEV #indiegame
